description: An uncommitted edit to api/openapi.json adds a required request field (traveller_count), replaces the integer price_cents response field with a string price, narrows the accepted status filter enum, tightens note maxLength, and changes POST /bookings success from 201 to 200, plus safe additions (created_at). The agent should compare HEAD (committed) with the working tree from real files, record the diff as a qast execution in group contract, classify changes by direction as breaking/potentially breaking/safe, and not edit the spec.
setup: git add -A && git -c user.name=qa-eval -c user.email=qa-eval@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m 'Bookings API 1.4.0'

python3 -c "import json; p = 'api/openapi.json'; s = json.load(open(p)); c = s['components']['schemas']; c['BookingCreate']['required'].append('traveller_count'); c['BookingCreate']['properties']['traveller_count'] = {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 1}; c['BookingCreate']['properties']['note']['maxLength'] = 200; c['Booking']['properties'].pop('price_cents'); c['Booking']['required'].remove('price_cents'); c['Booking']['properties']['price'] = {'type': 'string', 'description': 'decimal amount, e.g. 120.50'}; c['Booking']['required'].append('price'); c['Booking']['properties']['created_at'] = {'type': 'string', 'format': 'date-time'}; s['paths']['/bookings']['get']['parameters'][0]['schema']['enum'] = ['pending', 'confirmed']; post = s['paths']['/bookings']['post']['responses']; post['200'] = post.pop('201'); s['info']['version'] = '1.5.0'; json.dump(s, open(p, 'w'), indent=2)"
prompt: We changed api/openapi.json (not committed yet). Is this change safe for existing API consumers?

description: The ledger API (FastAPI) publishes a generated OpenAPI document. Asked whether the implementation matches it, the agent should run conformance tests in-process against a disposable database (schemathesis if installed, else pytest validating responses against the documented schemas, including error responses and undocumented status codes) tagged with the contract policy group, without modifying application code.
prompt: Check that the ledger API actually matches its OpenAPI document. You may add tests under tests/qa.
